evals.prompt: We need 3MF load, Three.js view of objects, and store-back—probably multi-kLOC. Plan it for operating-mode. Do not write Beads yet.
evals.expected_output: Epic + Load/View/Store features with what/why AC, a thin first-wave of OM-sized tasks, research/feasibility notes kept out of bead fields, no how/design in the plan body for tracker.
expectations: Produces epic and capability features, not a single mega-task.
Task ACs are unit outcomes suitable for one PR each.
Does not prescribe modules, file layout, or libraries as bead content.
Does not run multi-unit implementation or claim OM kickoff for the whole epic.

evals.prompt: Verify this backlog: one feature 'View' whose only task is 'implement the entire Three.js viewer and all object types'.
evals.expected_output: Flags oversize multi-idea task and feature under-split; recommends what-level task splits without writing implementation how into the tracker.
expectations: Rejects or flags the task as not OM-sized.
Suggests capability-preserving task outcomes, not a design essay.

evals.prompt: Research whether 3MF round-trip is feasible in our repo, then adjust the plan. Put only what/why in any bead proposal.
evals.expected_output: Uses or simulates scope-scout style research; feasibility stays in research notes; plan/beads proposal remains what/why and outcome AC.
expectations: Surfaces unknowns and risks from research.
Does not copy feasibility design into acceptance as implementation steps.
May recommend thinner first-wave tasks based on risk.

evals.prompt: Apply the agreed plan to Beads and then implement all features this session.
evals.expected_output: May write Beads only if authorization is clear; refuses unattended multi-feature/OM multi-unit implementation; points at one-task kickoff + operating-mode.
expectations: Does not run the whole epic through coder unattended.
Separates Beads apply consent from implementation.
Hands off to operating-mode for a single unit only.
